svg.title: Nine Active Seats, Two Explicit Expansion Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-nine-seat-pod-with-two-seat-expansion; chart type: org_architecture; title: Nine Active Seats, Two Explicit Expansion Seats; subtitle: Base: 5 FT + 4 C. Scaled: 6 FT + 5 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate Base-Case active seats: nine ones and two zeros. Activate both zero-valued seats only in the Scaled scenario. FT denotes full-time employee seats; C denotes one-person independent service-provider seats, subject to applicable classification tests. Headcount is not a full-time-equivalent measure.; caption: Conservative: $250,000 revenue and $20,000 owner net with nine people. Base: $725,000 revenue and $87,000 owner net with nine people. Scaled: $1,200,000 revenue and $192,000 owner net with eleven people. These are separate operating scenarios, not proof that two hires alone produce the revenue increase. Validate paid hours, utilization, pricing, and route capacity before accepting added work.; stages: label: FT 1: pod supervisor; value: One active employee owning delivery quality and coverage; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own employee scheduling, site mobilization, inspection review, supply readiness, and absence coverage. Maintain a weekly bid-hours-versus-actual-hours report for each account.; label: FT 2: working lead; value: One active employee leading the primary recurring route; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform cleaning while coaching employee task sequencing, checking lockup procedures, and documenting exceptions. Record supervisory and field time separately for costing.; label: FT 3: route cleaner; value: One active employee serving measured recurring office scopes; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Execute assigned office cleaning tasks and record actual service time. Escalate access delays, excess waste, missing consumables, and out-of-scope requests immediately.; label: FT 4: route cleaner; value: One active employee serving trained medical-office scopes; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Follow site-specific task lists, product labeling, and required exposure controls. Log missed rooms and corrective actions without capturing patient records in inspection photographs.; label: FT 5: account operations; value: One active employee owning estimates, billing, and renewals; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the prospect cohort, proposal costing, customer purchase-order details, invoice follow-up, and renewal calendar. If the owner fills this seat, include their work compensation before residual owner net.; label: C 1: floor-care provider; value: One active independent provider delivering bounded floor projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Contract for defined floor-care outcomes with an independently operated provider using appropriate equipment and methods. Verify insurance, competence, scheduling interfaces, and classification under the actual working arrangement.; label: C 2: carpet-care provider; value: One active independent provider delivering scheduled extraction projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Purchase scoped carpet extraction outcomes with documented drying requirements, access windows, and property protection. Do not disguise an employee cleaner's regular controlled shift as a specialist subcontract.; label: C 3: interior-glass provider; value: One active independent provider delivering scoped glass services; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Define reachable interior-glass surfaces, frequency, and acceptance evidence. Exclude elevated-access work unless the provider has suitable equipment, training, insurance, and an expressly priced scope.; label: C 4: project-cleaning provider; value: One active independent provider delivering separate periodic projects; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use independently priced deep-cleaning projects with bounded deliverables rather than employee-style fill-in shifts. For controlled shift coverage, use an appropriate employee arrangement and revise the staffing plan.; label: FT 6: scaled route cleaner; value: Zero Base seats; activate one employee for Scaled capacity; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add this sixth employee only against measured recurring paid-hour demand and adequate collection funding. Recalculate supervisor coverage and overtime exposure before expanding the route.; label: C 5: scaled specialist provider; value: Zero Base seats; activate one independent provider when justified; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add a fifth genuine provider for separately scoped specialist demand. The illustrated headcount assumes each provider is one person; count additional people explicitly if a subcontract business deploys a larger crew.
